text_block_list.text:
One day, while relaxing in my room, I 
received an e-mail from Thoresen Academy.

Attention all trainers at the Academy! 
There will be a big announcement 
concerning your future in the near future.

Be sure to check it out! From Akikawa 
[Akikawa], Chairman of the Board of 
Trustees of Tressen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Media, thank you for coming! 
Silence! I would like to propose…

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
Um, Ms. President～……! If you don't get on 
the platform to talk, they won't see……!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Mwah. That's right! Lost, lost!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
―Okay, that's better. Well then, once 
again!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Proposal! In the name of the chairman of 
the board of directors of Thoresen 
Academy, I hereby―

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I declare a new race, "URA Finals" 
！！！！
(Zawwah ……!!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text:
The "URA Finals" ……! You're creating a new 
race!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Chairman Akikawa! My name is Fumi Otome of 
"Monthly Twinkle". May I ask you a 
question?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Permission! What is it, Otomeishi!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Now then―

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
I understand that you are establishing a 
new race.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Fortuitous!! I'm glad you asked!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The "URA Finals" is a race that "gives 
every Uma Musume a chance.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Every Uma Musume will give it their all to 
reach the top! The best! The top! It's a 
race where you can compete!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text:
Give…… a chance to…… the top spot…… every 
Uma girl ……!
(mutter mutter mutter……!!)

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: ……… Huh. Hmmm. Hmmmmmmmmm… ……!!!

text_block_list.name: Otonashi Etsuko
text_block_list.text: Huh! ……! This is getting interesting… ……!

The race, "URA Finals," was suddenly 
announced. ……

Immediately after the press conference 
that shocked the racing world, a briefing 
session was held for the members of Tracen 
Academy.

We headed to the gymnasium, where the 
students and trainers had already 
gathered, and the room was filled with a 
buzz. ……

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
URA Finals or …… I wonder if it's okay, 
doing something so big as establishing a 
new race.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know……… I mean, she's still a kid, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
Her predecessor was really good, but it 
doesn't necessarily mean that her daughter 
is too.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text: ……I'm sorry to interrupt.

text_block_list.name: Hayakawa Tazuna
text_block_list.text:
We will have time for questions and 
answers after the presentation. If you 
have any questions, please ask then, okay?

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Tazuna, ……! I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

Looking at the surroundings, it seems that 
people are still more upset and anxious.

In the midst of all this…… finally began 
the "URA Finals" presentation by 
Chancellor Akikawa.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Gentlemen! Many of you may have been 
puzzled and anxious at the sudden 
announcement of ……

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
But! First of all, listen to me! The URA 
Finals, and what it means!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Meaning of ……?

The faces of the participants looked at 
each other in a stir. Then, at the perfect 
moment, the conversation was interrupted. 
Akikawa, the chairman of the board of 
trustees, raised her voice.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Gentlemen. ！！！！

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
―Have you ever had a frustrating 
experience?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I want to win the Arimakinen! I want to 
win the Derby! I want to be the best horse 
girl! Even if you think so…

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Have you ever had a race where you just 
couldn't match the distance or course, and 
you couldn't even show your ability?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
'My true power, the power of the horsegirl 
in charge, is not like this,' she bit her 
lip!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Gentlemen! I am aiming for a world where 
all Uma Musume who aspire to race will 
shine!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
The brilliance of the running Uma Musume 
is a clash of wills! My ideal is for the 
horsegirls to compete for the top spot 
with all their might and radiate their 
brilliance to each other!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
After all! I want to prepare a stage where 
all the horsegirls can show their best! I 
want to prepare it!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Chairman of the Board ……

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In a regular GI, the distance and course 
are established by the race.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: But―!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Scrape your eyes! In the URA Finals, we 
will have "all distances" and "all 
courses"!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All distances: ……!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All courses ……!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As with the Arima Kinen and Takarazuka 
Kinen, only the Uma Musume chosen by fan 
votes will be eligible to participate!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the representative Uma 
Musume who have been active in the Twinkle 
Series and won many fans―the "Star Uma 
Musume"―are the only ones who are eligible 
to run!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Uma Musume, ladies and gentlemen! Run on 
the stage where you can give it your all, 
and be the top of the URA Finals!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Why don't you try to win the title of 
"Finals Champion"?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Trainers! I want you to develop the 
talents of the horsegirls in your charge 
to the best of your ability.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't you like to see her crowned the 
first champion!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Come on! You will all gather fans and 
become "Star Uma Musume" for the first 
show of the New Year in three years!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Encouragement! Expectations! I'm waiting 
for your success!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaahhhh ……!!!)

The situation before the briefing changed 
dramatically, and the room was filled with 
applause and cheers that did not cease for 
a while.

Thus, the new tournament to close out the 
year, the "URA Finals," was declared open!
